description: Mint a NARROWER credential from the one you are holding, and hand it to a subtask. This is how you avoid giving a helper agent the whole account: an hour of life, one deployment, no spending. The child can never exceed you on any axis — scopes, lifetime, daily or monthly budget, resource quotas, or which resources it may touch — and asking for more is refused, not silently trimmed. Returns the token ONCE; it is not readable afterwards. Revoking this credential revokes everything it minted. Use it whenever you are about to delegate: the narrowest credential that can finish the job is the one to hand over. Only options advertised by this connection's input schema are supported. Use a connection that exposes monthly caps, quotas or additional human-approval policies when those restrictions are needed; never assume an unsupported field imposes a restriction.

label.description: What this credential is for, shown to the owner in impreza_list_credentials. Say the task, e.g. "redeploy blog after CI".

resources.description: Provide explicit resource boundaries when delegating, e.g. {"deployment":["dpl_abc"]}. Kinds: deployment, service and domain. Within a supplied resource filter, a kind you do not name is unavailable to the child. The child cannot exceed your grant.

scopes.description: What the child may do: a subset of ["read","deploy","manage"]. Naming a higher scope than you hold is refused.

spend_cap_cents.description: Daily purchase ceiling in cents of the account currency. Default 0 = cannot spend. Requires the manage scope and cannot exceed what you have left today.

ttl_seconds.description: How long it lives (60 to 2592000, default 3600). Clamped to your own remaining lifetime.

name: impreza_mint_subcredential
title: Mint narrower credential
